newsitem.title: USA: Mesa Air Group delays earnings report.
newsitem.headline: Mesa Air Group delays earnings report.

text.p: Mesa Air Group said Wednesday it will delay its quarterly earnings announcement originally scheduled to be made Thursday, July 24.

The delay is a result of July 21 and 22 announcements, respectively, by United Airlines and Skywest Airlines that United and Skywest have entered into a code-share agreement covering United's Los Angeles hub, Mesa said.
The new agreement would take eight markets away from Mesa's WestAir subsidiary and award them to Skywest, the company said.

Because of the potential material impact of this agreement on Mesa's financial position, the company said it needs more time to evaluate the effect of the Skywest agreement upon its quarter which ended June 30.
